bullets.id: Emas spot menutup pekan di $4.140,52, turun 3,09% sepekan setelah dibuka di $4.277,90; low pekan $4.110,95 hanya sekitar $11 di atas level $4.100. Survei Kitco: 6 dari 13 analis Wall Street bearish dan hanya 3 bullish, sementara Main Street tak lagi mayoritas bullish (47% bullish, 33% bearish).
bullets.en: Spot gold ended the week at $4,140.52, down 3.09% after opening at $4,277.90; the weekly low of $4,110.95 sat only about $11 above $4,100. Kitco survey: 6 of 13 Wall Street analysts are bearish and only 3 bullish, while Main Street no longer has a bullish majority (47% bullish, 33% bearish).

bullets.id: Indeks dolar di 101,93 menuju kenaikan mingguan ketiga (naik 0,9% sepekan, 3,06% sebulan), dan yield 10 tahun di level tertinggi sejak 2002. Peluang kenaikan Fed Oktober sekitar 20%, tapi untuk Desember masih di atas 80%. Emas turun 7,45% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The dollar index at 101.93 is headed for a third weekly gain (up 0.9% on the week, 3.06% on the month), and the 10-year yield is at its highest since 2002. October Fed hike odds are about 20%, but December odds remain above 80%. Gold is down 7.45% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Agenda pekan ini: ISM Jasa Senin (perkiraan 55,1 dari 55,4), risalah FOMC Rabu, klaim pengangguran Kamis (perkiraan 200 ribu), lalu sentimen konsumen Michigan Jumat; lelang obligasi 10 dan 30 tahun juga bisa menggerakkan yield. CPI AS menyusul 14 Oktober. Level yang dipantau: $4.100 di bawah dan $4.200–4.300 di atas.
bullets.en: This week’s agenda: ISM Services on Monday (forecast 55.1 from 55.4), FOMC minutes on Wednesday, jobless claims on Thursday (forecast 200K), then Michigan consumer sentiment on Friday; the 10- and 30-year bond auctions could also move yields. US CPI follows on October 14. Levels in focus: $4,100 below and $4,200–4,300 above.

bullets.id: Logam Mulia tidak memperbarui harga di akhir pekan, jadi Antam tetap Rp2.574.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.380.000 (spread 7,5%); sepekan turun Rp23.000. Galeri24 turun Rp5.000 ke Rp2.506.000 (buyback Rp2.364.000) dan UBS ke Rp2.530.000 (buyback Rp2.338.000). Bank sentral membeli 289 ton di Q2.
bullets.en: Logam Mulia does not update prices over the weekend, so Antam stays at Rp2,574,000/gram with a Rp2,380,000 buyback (7.5% spread); it fell Rp23,000 over the week. Galeri24 fell Rp5,000 to Rp2,506,000 (buyback Rp2,364,000) and UBS to Rp2,530,000 (buyback Rp2,338,000). Central banks bought 289t in Q2.
